title: Rory and the Soft Moonlit Grove
verses:
The sun faded down as the sky turned to blue,
The quiet old valley was covered in dew.
And Rory walked on with a soft, gentle tread,
To find a cozy place for a nap in his bed.

Nia soared down from the stars up above,
And sang a sweet lullaby full of her love.
Psittaco nestled right into a leaf,
Exchanging the day for a quiet relief.

Ricky stopped bouncing and sat on the ground,
He listened to night as it whispered around.
Tilly tucked close by the side of a tree,
As happy and calm as a dino could be.

Benny lay down with a deep, heavy sigh,
While watching the moon as it floated on high.
The silver light glowed on the moss softly spread,
And cushioned the ground where he laid down his head.

Together they settled in warmth and in peace,
And waited for all of their worries to cease.
The fireflies danced as they flickered a glow,
To rock all the friends in a rhythm so slow.

Now Rory has closed his two tired old eyes,
Beneath the soft blanket of starry dark skies.
The valley is dreaming, the world is asleep,
Rest well, little friends, in a slumber so deep.
